summary: the row of tests/system/init_refusal.sh, a root whose /sbin/init is a link to itself, which the kernel must refuse and halt on, with the kernel built from a private copy of rach2/ and mk/ and the lookup's test of -ENOENT widened to any failure

argv:
set -e
RACH2_ARCH=${ARCH:-i686}
tree=${WORK}/tree
REPO=$tree
. ./mk/arch.sh
sh tests/proofs/guest.sh make build/tests/system/harness build/tests/system/runutil build/tools/image/mkmbr build/tools/inspect/elfcheck
if [ ! -d "$tree" ]; then
    mkdir -p "$tree/build/tools/inspect"
    cp -R rach2 mk "$tree/"
    printf 'build/tools/inspect/elfcheck: ;\n' >"$tree/Makefile"
fi
cp build/tools/inspect/elfcheck "$tree/build/tools/inspect/elfcheck"
cp ${SRC}/rach2/kernel.c "$tree/rach2/kernel.c"
rm -f "$ARCH_BUILD/rach2/kernel.o" "$ARCH_BUILD/rach2/kernel"
make -s -j8 -C "$tree/rach2" "ARCH=$RACH2_ARCH"
cp "$ARCH_BUILD/rach2/kernel" ${WORK}/kernel

RACH2_ARCH=${ARCH:-i686}
REPO=$(pwd)
. ./mk/arch.sh
RACH2_QEMU=$ARCH_QEMU
export RACH2_QEMU
status=0
sh tests/system/init_refusal.sh ${WORK}/kernel build/tests/system/harness build/tools/image/mkmbr ${WORK}/row || status=$?
cat ${WORK}/row.log 2>/dev/null
exit $status

faults.name: fallthrough
faults.summary: the init lookup's test of -ENOENT widened to any failure, which takes a link loop for an absent init and opens the debug shell

lines: no /sbin/init in the root; falling back to the debug shell
